title: SWF: PlaceObject2 tween color transform (motion tween)
description: Test that a layer with motion tween and keyframe color changes produces PlaceObject2 with HasColorTransform flag (0x08) set. Verify: (1) the CXFormWithAlpha is encoded with correct Nbits, (2) multiply values in range [0, 256] use 10-bit fields, (3) add values use signed fields, (4) a fully transparent tween (alpha=0) produces aa_mult=0, (5) normal (no color change) tween has no CXForm.
